name: homeless, the vagabond
source:
Boys and girls linked with vagabond life style and love for musical instruments talk about various things. The impression on the talk determines the ending.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
与流浪生活方式和对乐器的热爱紧密相连的男孩女孩们谈论各种事情。谈话给人的印象将决定结局。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
